---
title: "What are the tail volume coefficients?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 20.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 5.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 120.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 26.3      # s the probe actually used

res = optimize_glider_3mm(verbose=False)
c_root, taper, cg_x = res['c_root'], res['taper'], res['cg_x']
glider = make_glider_3mm(c_root, taper, cg_x)

wings = {w.name: w for w in glider.wings}
wing, hstab, vstab = wings['Wing'], wings['H-tail'], wings['V-tail']

Sw, cw, bw = wing.area(), wing.mean_aerodynamic_chord(), wing.span()
Sh, Sv = hstab.area(), vstab.area()

lh_cg = hstab.aerodynamic_center()[0] - cg_x
lv_cg = vstab.aerodynamic_center()[0] - cg_x

Vh_cg = (Sh * lh_cg) / (Sw * cw)
Vv_cg = (Sv * lv_cg) / (Sw * bw)
```

::: {.hero-pair}
[`{python} f"{Vh_cg:.2f}"`]{.hero-value}
[Horizontal tail volume coefficient $V_H$]{.hero-label}

[`{python} f"{Vv_cg:.3f}"`]{.hero-value}
[Vertical tail volume coefficient $V_V$]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The horizontal tail volume coefficient ($V_H$) from the optimized center of gravity is [`{python} f"{Vh_cg:.2f}"`]{.key}, and the vertical tail volume coefficient ($V_V$) is [`{python} f"{Vv_cg:.3f}"`]{.key}.
